\section{Overview}

Declarations of the Lean module \texttt{TCSlib.BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.Noise.BooleanCharacteristic}.

\section{Declarations}

\begin{definition}[Normalized cube blocks]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.normalizedCubeBlocks}
\label{BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.normalizedCubeBlocks}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.BoolCube, BooleanAnalysis.boolToSign}
For natural numbers $n$ and $m$ and a Boolean vector $x\in\{0,1\}^{nm}$, define
$z\in\bbr^n$ by
\[
z_i=\frac{1}{\sqrt m}\sum_{j=1}^m \varepsilon\bigl(x_{(i,j)}\bigr),\qquad i=1,\ldots,n,
\]
where $\varepsilon$ is the sign encoding of a Boolean value and the coordinate $(i,j)$
is identified with its position in the length-$nm$ vector.
\end{definition}

\begin{lemma}[Factorization of a Boolean coordinate sum]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.sum_pair_coordinate_products}
\label{BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.sum_pair_coordinate_products}
\leanok
\difficulty{3}
Let $\iota$ be a finite set and let $H_i:\{0,1\}\times\{0,1\}\to\mathbb C$ be arbitrary
for each $i\in\iota$. Then the sum over all pairs of Boolean vectors of the product of
their coordinate contributions factors as
\[\sum_{x,y\in\{0,1\}^{\iota}}\prod_{i\in\iota}H_i(x_i,y_i)=\prod_{i\in\iota}\sum_{b,c\in\{0,1\}}H_i(b,c).\]
\end{lemma}

\begin{lemma}[Correlated sign phase sum]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.sum_correlatedSign_phase}
\label{BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.sum_correlatedSign_phase}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.correlatedSignCharacteristic, BooleanAnalysis.boolToSign}
\difficulty{3}
Let $\rho,a,b\in\mathbb R$, and let $\sigma(\mathrm{false})=1$ and
$\sigma(\mathrm{true})=-1$. Then the sum over $x,y\in\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$
of $\frac{1+\rho\sigma(x)\sigma(y)}{4}\exp\!\bigl(i(a\sigma(x)+b\sigma(y))\bigr)$ equals
the complex number whose real value before embedding in $\mathbb C$ is
$\frac{1+\rho}{2}\cos(a+b)+\frac{1-\rho}{2}\cos(a-b)$.
\end{lemma}

\begin{lemma}[Noise kernel phase identity]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.sum_noiseKernel_phase}
\label{BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.sum_noiseKernel_phase}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.BoolCube, BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.correlatedSignCharacteristic, BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.sum_correlatedSign_phase, BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.sum_pair_coordinate_products, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.noiseKernel, BooleanAnalysis.boolToSign, BooleanAnalysis.uniformWeight}
\difficulty{5}
Let $N\in\mathbb N$, $\rho\in\mathbb R$, and $a,b\colon\{1,\ldots,N\}\to\mathbb R$. With
$\sigma(\mathrm{false})=1$, $\sigma(\mathrm{true})=-1$, and
$K_\rho(x,y)=\prod_{i=1}^N\frac{1+\rho\sigma(x_i)\sigma(y_i)}2$, one has
$2^{-N}\sum_{x,y\in\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}^N}K_\rho(x,y)\exp\!\bigl(i\sum_{i=1}^N(a_i\sigma(x_i)+b_i\sigma(y_i))\bigr)=\prod_{i=1}^N\left(\frac{1+\rho}{2}\cos(a_i+b_i)+\frac{1-\rho}{2}\cos(a_i-b_i)\right)$.
\end{lemma}

\begin{lemma}[Phase identity for normalized cube blocks]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.phase_normalizedCubeBlocks}
\label{BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.phase_normalizedCubeBlocks}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.BoolCube, BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.normalizedCubeBlocks, BooleanAnalysis.boolToSign}
\difficulty{4}
Let $n,m$ be nonnegative integers, let $a,b:\{0,\ldots,n-1\}\to\mathbb R$, and let $x,y$
be Boolean vectors of length $nm$. Then
\[
\sum_{i=0}^{n-1}\bigl(a_i A_i(x)+b_i A_i(y)\bigr)
=
\sum_{k=0}^{nm-1}\left(\frac{a_{i(k)}}{\sqrt m}\sigma(x_k)+\frac{b_{i(k)}}{\sqrt
m}\sigma(y_k)\right),
\]
where $A_i(z)$ is the sum of the signs of the entries in block $i$, divided by $\sqrt
m$, and $i(k)$ is the block index of coordinate $k$ under the standard identification of
coordinates with pairs in $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}\times\{0,\ldots,m-1\}$. Here $\sigma$ sends
Boolean values to their signs, with false mapped to $1$ and true to $-1$.
\end{lemma}

\begin{lemma}[Block noise phase identity]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.sum_noiseKernel_normalizedCubeBlocks_phase}
\label{BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.sum_noiseKernel_normalizedCubeBlocks_phase}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.BoolCube, BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.correlatedSignCharacteristic, BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.normalizedCubeBlocks, BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.phase_normalizedCubeBlocks, BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.sum_noiseKernel_phase, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.noiseKernel, BooleanAnalysis.uniformWeight}
\difficulty{3}
Let $n,m\in\mathbb N$, $\rho\in\mathbb R$, and $a,b\colon\{1,\ldots,n\}\to\mathbb R$.
For a Boolean vector $x$ of length $nm$, divide its coordinates into $n$ blocks of
length $m$ and let $z_i(x)$ be the sum of the signs in block $i$, divided by $\sqrt m$.
With $\sigma(\mathrm{false})=1$, $\sigma(\mathrm{true})=-1$, and
$K_\rho(x,y)=\prod_{r=1}^{nm}\frac{1+\rho\sigma(x_r)\sigma(y_r)}2$, one has
$2^{-nm}\sum_{x,y}K_\rho(x,y)\exp\!\bigl(i\sum_i(a_i z_i(x)+b_i
z_i(y))\bigr)=\prod_{i=1}^n\left(\frac{1+\rho}{2}\cos\!\left(\frac{a_i+b_i}{\sqrt
m}\right)+\frac{1-\rho}{2}\cos\!\left(\frac{a_i-b_i}{\sqrt m}\right)\right)^m$, where
both sums range over Boolean vectors of length $nm$.
\end{lemma}

\begin{lemma}[Gaussian limit of cube noise phases]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.tendsto_sum_noiseKernel_normalizedCubeBlocks_phase}
\label{BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.tendsto_sum_noiseKernel_normalizedCubeBlocks_phase}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.BoolCube, BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.correlatedGaussianMeasure, BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.correlatedSignCharacteristic, BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.integral_exp_correlatedGaussianMeasure, BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.normalizedCubeBlocks, BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.sum_noiseKernel_normalizedCubeBlocks_phase, BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.tendsto_correlatedSignCharacteristic_pow, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.noiseKernel, BooleanAnalysis.uniformWeight}
\difficulty{5}
Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\rho\in[-1,1]$, and let $a,b\in\mathbb R^n$. For each
natural number $m$, average over all pairs $x,y\in\{0,1\}^{nm}$ the noise kernel at
parameter $\rho$ times the complex phase whose angle is the sum, over the $n$ blocks, of
the corresponding coordinates of $a$ and $b$ paired with the normalized sign sums of $x$
and $y$. After multiplying this average by $2^{-nm}$, the resulting sequence converges
as $m\to\infty$ to the expectation of the phase with angle $\sum_{i=1}^n(a_i Z_i+b_i
W_i)$, where $(Z,W)$ has the correlated Gaussian measure of parameter $\rho$ on $\mathbb
R^n\times\mathbb R^n$.
\end{lemma}
